msgs.t: Lecturer says references in APA 7th or it's marked down. No exceptions.

slides.b: Surname, Initials. (Year). Title. Every entry starts the same way.
Sort the list by the first author's surname. Hanging indent on every entry.
Book or journal name in italics. Article titles plain, first word capitalised.

slides.h: Three or more authors: et al.
slides.b: In the text, (Wanjiru et al., 2021). The full list of names goes in the reference list.
If the article has a DOI, end the entry with https://doi.org/ and the number.
